title: oscore: KeyUpdateContext::update() bypasses OwnershipRegistry (stuck claim + unclaimed new record)
description: rust/lichen-oscore/src/lib.rs:201/236-237: KeyUpdateContext::update() swaps the live context to a NEW ContextId via bare candidate.register_fresh without registry knowledge. For a registry-claimed context: (a) the old claim is stuck — release() with the new context returns false and the old id cannot be released without reconstructing old key material; (b) the new record is live and unclaimed — recreating the concurrent-receiver hazard. Fix: registry-aware rekey API (atomic release-old + claim-new), or minimally document a prohibition on update() for registry-managed contexts plus a debug assertion.
